summary: This bill designates the VA community-based outpatient clinic in San Jose, California, as the Corporal Patrick D. Tillman VA Clinic, requiring all U.S. government references to use that name.

scores.thoughts: The bill is a purely ceremonial naming designation for an existing VA clinic. It contains no provisions that authorize, expand, or reduce any government spending.
The bill contains no tax-related provisions of any kind.
While the bill names a VA healthcare facility, the action is limited to designation and does not alter healthcare policy, coverage, or delivery models.
No provisions related to firearms or gun regulations appear in the bill.
The bill has no connection to immigration policy or border enforcement.
No content in the bill addresses reproductive rights or abortion access.
The bill honors a deceased service member but does not alter military funding, force structure, or defense policy.
No environmental or climate-related provisions are present.
Naming a VA clinic does not expand or contract veterans' benefits or any social safety-net programs.
The bill contains no education policy provisions.
No drug-policy content exists in the legislation.
The bill does not address criminal justice, sentencing, or policing.
No trade or tariff provisions are included.
The bill has no fiscal impact on deficits or the national debt.
No provisions relate to LGBTQ+ legal protections.
The legislation does not address foreign aid.
No election or voting provisions are present.
The bill contains no technology or privacy regulations.
No labor or union-related content appears.
The bill does not engage with religious liberty or anti-discrimination issues.
